name: HyprPanel
summary: All-in-one panel for Hyprland with dashboards, notifications and a settings dialog.
description: An all-in-one panel for Hyprland built with Astal: bar, dashboard, notifications, media and system controls, with a graphical settings dialog. It is in maintenance mode and about to be archived; its author now works on Wayle, a compositor-agnostic successor written in Rust. Installed from the AUR as ags-hyprpanel-git.
